integrity: Unrestricted elementary proof using the Gauss–Wantzel factorization, exact totient and divisor-sum identities, prime-order obstruction for Fermat factors \(F_j\) with \(j\ge2\), and the \(641\)-factor obstruction for the Fermat prefix. Finite exact computations only corroborate the proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to \(n>1\) with \(\varphi(n)\) a power of \(2\). The unrestricted A116083 conjecture remains unresolved for totients with odd prime divisors.
title: The complete constructible-totient slice of the unit commutator equation
